notes: Context-only: no blocking or decision control. additionalContext is injected into Claude's context before the first prompt; systemMessage is a user-facing warning, not Claude context. Input also optionally carries agent_type (with claude --agent <name>) and session_title. When source is 'resume' or 'fork' and the transcript has at least one Claude response, four resume-cost fields are added (Claude Code v2.1.251+): seconds_since_last_response, context_tokens, prompt_cache_likely_expired, estimated_cache_write_usd. Claude Code ignores initialUserMessage and sessionTitle from a plugin that finishes installing after the SessionStart hooks have run. CLAUDE_ENV_FILE is not available to a hook that runs in PowerShell; PowerShell commands receive its variables (Claude Code v2.1.296 or later) only when every line is a plain assignment, a blank line or a comment.
